text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty HIGH — control-plane elevated 5xx rate detected (auth + org-lookup + billing) across gateway. Service impact: increased request failures to Redwood API. Escalation: oncall Sam. https://pagerduty.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:

sam (oncall): acked. joining. starting triage.

anya: saw spike at ~1815122900, 5xx rate -> 12% on gateway for last 5m. latency for control-plane calls also increased.

kevin: confirm logs show auth service returning 502s to gateway, org-lookup times out at 1s->3s then 504.

lucy: tagging customers with high request volume: orgs /acme, /beta-inc — they might see failed token checks.

jordan: adding prod-alert channel for visibility.

sam (oncall): status update: likely cascading failures from auth pool. running quick health checks.

sam (oncall): run: ```curl -v https://auth.redwood.example/health```
ops-bot: auth.health -> 200 ok on 2/6 pods; 4/6 returning 5xx or hanging.

anya: sharing recent deploy? There was a config rollout 1815120000 that touched auth cache eviction.

kevin: I'm rolling back that config on auth to previous stable. patch id: cfg-2026-17.

lucy: gateway is adding backoff retries; but retries are causing queueing and higher latencies. consider temporary retry disable for auth routes.

sam (oncall): action items: 1) kevin rollback cfg-2026-17 (in progress), 2) jordan and ops-bot to scale auth replicas + remove retry policy on gateway for auth, 3) anya to monitor 5xx and customer impact page.

kevin: rollback started: kubectl rollout undo deployment/auth-service -n redwood-prod --to-revision=3
kevin: logs show config reload failing on some nodes due to oom during reload. suspect memory regression.

jordan: scaling auth: kubectl scale deployment/auth-service --replicas=10 -n redwood-prod (was 6). applying now.

ops-bot: Scaling event initiated by jordan. New replica target=10.

lucy: disabling gateway retries for auth routes: editing gateway route config and reloading envoy (safe deploy), will keep a temporary 1s timeout.

sam (oncall): Maria, can you open a customer-impact note? list orgs impacted and mitigation steps.

maria: opened incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incident/INC12345. Noting ACME and BETA-INC saw token failures and elevated client errors. Communicated to support to delay retries.

anya: metrics update: auth 5xx down from 12% -> 4.5% after scale + rollback; org-lookup timeouts dropped from 3s -> 700ms. gateway 5xx dropped to 3%. still above baseline but trending down.

kevin: confirm rollback finished on all pods, restarting ones with bad mem config. Monitoring for OOMs.

sam (oncall): good. keeping incident as P1 until stable <1% 5xx for 10m. handing off to next oncall in 20m — lucy will take over.

lucy: taking handoff at 1815123720. I'll keep watch and continue to debug memory regression root cause. planning: collect heap/dumps from failed pods and correlate with cfg-2026-17 change.

jordan: left notes about gateway retry disable and scaling steps in runbook.

maria: support broadcast prepared: templated message for affected customers, will send once we reach stable state and confirm no data loss.

ops-bot: Reminder: create postmortem ticket and assign to kevin/lucy for RCA and to product for config gating.

sam (oncall): thanks team — nice quick mitigation. keep updates in thread. will remove P1 tag after 30m of stable metrics. :thumbsup:
